optimizer: Adam defaults; no weight decay; same order and exposures across paired controls
precision: FP32 parameters and optimizer; PyTorch TF32 disabled; installed FLA solver internal TF32 disclosed
vocab_sizes_note: Constructor placeholders only; replaced before training by training-vocabulary-dependent head sizes
vocabulary: Only rewrite training inputs before terminal EOS; preserve pinned Engram compressed-token normalization, padding and orders 2/3/4; never add evaluation keys
head_layout: Two dimension-32 heads per order; hash uses original consecutive-prime rule at U buckets plus a reserved zero row. Exact has U logical key rows plus zero and never-addressed padding to match hash physical row bytes/parameters exactly
initialization: Exact per-key rows clone corresponding matched hash bucket rows, including all heads; identical nonrow parameters and initial effective vectors by seed
primary_oov: Unseen canonical keys use identical all-zero embedding in both variants; zero rows remain frozen
deployment_control: The same trained hash checkpoint is separately evaluated with its ordinary open-vocabulary bucket lookup; no extra training or evaluation-vocabulary indexing
targets: Rewrite target_new and EOS only; all prompt losses and duplicate fillers masked
checkpoint_rule: Final fixed epoch only; no test-based model, epoch, key-domain or hyperparameter selection
calibration: Official case index modulo 10 equals zero; other cases test; both folds rewrite facts edited, paraphrases/neighborhoods never trained
primary_comparison: Exact minus equal-row-budget hash under identical trained-key coverage, paired by seed and official case; report all ES/PS/NS and 2000 paired bootstrap replicates
claim_gate: Positive test harmonic-score interval with no more than 2 percentage points test locality regression; separately test against the open-vocabulary hash deployment control. Three seeds and shared subjects limit inference
limitations: Frozen-backbone learned-memory editing, not pretraining or verified real facts. Canonical normalization still merges raw token identities. Full vocabulary key/index costs count in storage. No advantage is claimed before complete results; no generation metrics or native serving dominance follows
